title: Magnolia: A Persistent-Memory Agent Framework for Computational Chemistry
abstract: arXiv:2610.27230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chemistry has recently entered a high-data regime as molecular databases from high-throughput platforms or computational studies have become available. Increasing automation within the chemical sciences leads to a more digital and precision chemistry. Dedicated scientific agents are becoming central to guiding the chemist through an ever-increasing amount of data and findings, including negative ones. Here, we introduce Magnolia, a persistent-memory artificial intelligence agent framework that integrates computational protocols, from docking to quantum chemistry, lab notebooks and chat logs relying on large language models (LLMs). translated_title: Magnolia：一个面向计算化学的持久记忆智能体框架
translated_abstract: 化学领域近来已进入高数据量时代，来自高通量平台或计算研究的分子数据库日益丰富。化学科学中不断增长的自动化正推动化学走向更加数字化和精准化的方向。专门的科学智能体正在成为核心工具，引导化学家应对不断增长的数据和研究发现，其中包括负面的结果。本文介绍了Magnolia，一个持久记忆人工智能智能体框架，它依托大型语言模型（LLM），整合了从分子对接到量子化学的各种计算协议、实验记录本以及聊天日志。该框架依赖于三层记忆系统：会话级别的观察会被自动捕获并提炼为结构化的经验总结，经确认后提升为项目级别的条目，而当经过人工验证后，则会晋升为跨项目规则，从而主动指导后续工作并提供直接的化学反馈。
tldr: Magnolia是一个基于大语言模型的持久记忆智能体框架，通过三层记忆系统将会话观察逐步提炼为项目经验乃至经人工验证的跨项目规则，整合计算化学协议、实验记录与对话日志，为化学研究提供主动指导和化学反馈。
en_tdlr: Magnolia is a persistent-memory LLM-based agent framework for computational chemistry that distills session observations into project-level entries and human-validated cross-project rules through a three-tier memory system, integrating computational protocols, lab notebooks, and chat logs to actively guide research with chemical feedback.
